title: Method and apparatus of producing a surface with alternating ridges and depressions
abstract: A method of machining and a tool is used for obtaining patterns in the form of alternating ridges, pads, cells, and ridges of a triangular cross section on the surface of a blank. The method facilitates selection of the geometrical parameters of the tool and the machining mode for the tool to obtain alternating ridges and depressions with parallel sides of the profile at predetermined intervals and predetermined heights and angles of slope. The width of the space between projections can be varied in the range of millimeters and micrometers.
claim1: 1. A method for producing on a blank a surface having a profile of alternating ridges and depressions with parallel sides, comprising: as a first step, employing a tool with a rectilinear cutting edge having: a main angle φ in a plan of said tool according to a relationship: φ=arcsin a/(S·ε)! where a=a given thickness of a ridge S=a given pitch of said ridges of said profile ε=a distortion factor of said ridge profile equal to between 0.9 and 1.1, an auxiliary angle φ 1 in said plan view of said tool equal to (90°-ψ), where ψ is a preset angle of deviation of a projection of said ridge from a vertical position with respect to said blank, a depth of penetration t equal to t= h·ε-S·cos (φ-ψ)/2!·(sin φ/cos ψ), where h=a given height of said ridges of said profile, and a feed S o equal to said pitch of said ridges, and as a second step, moving said blank and said tool relative to each other, and undercutting and plastically deforming a surface layer of said blank with said tool while preserving an undercut layer on said surface to form alternating ridges and depressions with parallel sides.

title: Method of producing a liquid cooled coldplate
events: 2016-05-16 | Application filed by Wolverine Tube Inc
abstract: A liquid cooled coldplate has a tub with an inlet port and an outlet port and a plurality of pockets recessed within a top surface of the tub. Each pocket has a peripheral opening and a ledge, the ledge disposed inwardly and downwardly from the peripheral opening. The inlet port and outlet port are in fluid communication with the pocket via an inlet slot and an outlet slot. A plurality of cooling plates are each received by a pocket and recessed within the pocket. Each cooling plate comprises an electronics side for receiving electronics and enhanced side for cooling the cooling plate. The enhanced side of the cooling plate comprises a plurality of pins formed by micro deformation technology. The tub may be formed by extrusion.
claim1: 1. A method of producing a liquid cooled coldplate, the method comprising: forming a tub from metal, the tub comprising an inlet port, and outlet port, and a plurality of pockets, wherein the plurality of pockets are formed in a top surface of the tub and are in fluid communication with the inlet port and outlet port; forming a plurality of cooling plates by slicing fins into flat metal plates with a tool to form an enhanced surface, where the tool slices into the cooling metal layer to a depth less than the cooling metal layer thickness, and where the slicing step forces sliced material upwards without removing material from the cooling metal layer, the slicing step forming the fins to a fin height extending beyond an outer surface of the cooling metal layer, then slicing across the fins at an angle to form pins which extend beyond an outer surface of the cooling plates; installing each cooling plate into a pocket such that a chamber is formed between the tub and the cooling plate and the pinned surface is within the chamber and in fluid communication with the chamber, the inlet port, and the outlet port; installing electronic components onto the cooling plate on a side opposite to the pinned surface.

title: Mini-channel cold plate with three-dimensional adaptive flow-path using bi-metal fins
events: 2022-06-23 | Application filed by Hamilton Sundstrand Corp
abstract: The present disclosure provides for cooling systems, assemblies and methods (e.g., for semiconductor devices; for refrigerant cooling; for cryogenic cooling). More particularly, the present disclosure provides for mini-channel cold plate cooling assemblies, systems and methods for semiconductor devices (e.g., wide-bandgap (WBG) power semiconductor devices), with the cooling assemblies, systems and methods utilizing three-dimensional adaptive flow-paths using bi-metal fins. The present disclosure provides for mini-channel cold plate cooling assemblies, systems and methods that may improve cooling performance and/or enable local cooling control. The present disclosure provides for bi-metal strips that operate as both the surface-temperature sensors and actuators without input energy. The bi-metal strips guide the coolant flow to a low-drag channel when the surface temperature is low, and guide the coolant flow to the near-surface channel when the surface temperature is high.
claim1: 1. A cooling assembly comprising: a cold plate top wall attached to a first cold plate side wall and a second cold plate side wall, the first cold plate side wall attached to a cold plate bottom wall and including a coolant inlet, and the second cold plate side wall attached to the cold plate bottom wall and including a coolant outlet; a substrate positioned on the cold plate top wall, the substrate having a plurality of semiconductor devices positioned on the substrate; a plurality of bi-metal fins extending from the cold plate top wall towards the cold plate bottom wall; wherein heat from a semiconductor device of the plurality of semiconductor devices causes a coolant introduced between the cold plate top wall and the cold plate bottom wall to raise temperature of the coolant, which causes a bi-metal fin positioned proximal to the heated semiconductor device to deform and change a flow path of the coolant from the coolant inlet to the coolant outlet; and a plurality of wall extensions extending from the cold plate bottom wall towards the cold plate top wall, the plurality of wall extensions defining a plurality of lower channels for the coolant; and wherein each bi-metal fin of the plurality of bi-metal fins includes a side wall portion and a bottom wall portion, with each bi-metal fin extending from the cold plate top wall to define a plurality of adjustable upper channels for the coolant.

title: Preparation method of large-size flaky diamond/copper composite material with ultrahigh thermal conductivity
events: 2020-06-18 | Application filed by Harbin Jinwei Technology Co ltd
abstract: A preparation method of a large-size flaky diamond/copper composite material with ultrahigh thermal conductivity relates to a preparation method of a diamond/copper composite material. Aims to solve the problems of low thermal conductivity and poor interface bonding strength of the diamond/copper composite material. The method comprises the following steps: filling the diamond particles coated with the metal film into a cavity of a graphite mold to obtain a prefabricated body; placing the preform in a crucible, placing massive pure copper and copper alloy on the upper part of the preform in the crucible, placing the preform in an air pressure infiltration furnace, regulating and controlling the structure and shape of an interface layer material under the argon protective atmosphere, heating to melt copper, preserving heat, carrying out pressure-maintaining infiltration, and finally carrying out pressure-maintaining stepped cooling. The volume fraction of diamond in the obtained composite material member is 60-85%, the thermal conductivity reaches 1500W/mK, the side length reaches 60-130 mm, and the thickness reaches 0.2-4 mm. The invention is suitable for preparing the diamond/copper composite material with high thermal conductivity.

title: A nanofluid self-dispersing microchannel heat sink, space heat exchange system and method
events: 2024-07-12 | Application filed by Institute of Mechanics of CAS
abstract: The invention discloses a micro-channel heat sink, a space heat exchange system and a method for self-dispersing nano fluid in the technical field of electronic equipment heat dissipation, wherein a plurality of hydrodynamic cavitation flow channels are arranged side by side, and an inlet end and an outlet end of the hydrodynamic cavitation flow channels are respectively opposite to a nano working medium inlet and a nano working medium outlet; the hydrodynamic cavitation flow passage comprises an inlet section, a convergent section, a throat, a divergent section and an outlet section which are sequentially and continuously arranged; the sectional area of the tapered section is gradually reduced, so that the flow velocity of the nano fluid is increased, the pressure is reduced, and cavitation bubbles are generated; the sections of the throat are the same, so that the high flow speed and low pressure state of the nano fluid can be maintained, and cavitation bubbles are stably generated and increased; the sectional area of the tapered section is gradually increased, so that the flow velocity of the nano fluid is reduced, the pressure is increased, and cavitation bubbles collapse and impact the nano particles; the sections of the outlet section are the same, and the low-flow-rate and high-pressure state of the nano fluid can be maintained, so that cavitation bubbles are completely collapsed in the shell.

title: Chip hot spot cooling system based on nanometer magnetic fluid
assignee_original: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
events: 2021-06-29 | Application filed by Huazhong University of Science and Technology
abstract: Abstract Translated from Chinese 本发明公开了一种基于纳米磁流体的芯片热点冷却系统，属于芯片散热领域，该系统包括微通道主冷却单元、辅助冷却单元、冷水机组和系统控制器，微通道主冷却单元包括主微通道换热器、电磁阵列和纳米磁流体冷却液，冷水机组为芯片的整体散热提供冷量；电磁阵列形成磁场区域，利用纳米磁流体的磁热效应为芯片热点提供额外制冷量；辅助冷却单元包括辅微通道换热器和换热流体，用于带走纳米磁流体励磁时产生的热量。系统控制器包括控制单元、温度传感器和直流电源，可以动态监测芯片热点位置和温度，并通过调节磁场强度实现不同热点的定点动态散热。本发明能以较小的能耗实现芯片热点的快速冷却，有效预防芯片的局部热失效，提高芯片表面温度的均匀性。 The invention discloses a chip hot spot cooling system based on nano-magnetic fluid, belonging to the field of chip heat dissipation. The system includes a microchannel main cooling unit, an auxiliary cooling unit, a water chiller and a system controller. The microchannel main cooling unit includes a main microchannel Heat exchanger, electromagnetic array and nano-magnetic fluid cooling liquid, the chiller provides cooling capacity for the overall heat dissipation of the chip; the electromagnetic array forms a magnetic field area, and uses the magnetocaloric effect of the nano-magnetic fluid to provide additional cooling capacity for the hot spot of the chip; the auxiliary cooling unit includes auxiliary cooling capacity. The microchannel heat exchanger and heat exchange fluid are used to take away the heat generated when the nanomagnetic fluid is excited. The system controller includes a control unit, a temperature sensor and a DC power supply, which can dynamically monitor the location and temperature of chip hot spots, and realize fixed-point dynamic heat dissipation of different hot spots by adjusting the magnetic field strength. The invention can realize the rapid cooling of the hot spot of the chip with less energy consumption, effectively prevent the local thermal failure of the chip, and improve the uniformity of the surface temperature of the chip.
claim1: 1. A chip hot spot cooling system based on nanometer magnetic fluid is characterized by comprising a micro-channel main cooling unit, an auxiliary cooling unit and a water chilling unit (1); the micro-channel main cooling unit comprises a main micro-channel heat exchanger (5), an electromagnetic array (7) and a main flow path (9), wherein the main micro-channel heat exchanger (5) internally comprises a plurality of micro-channels, and two ends of each micro-channel heat exchanger are connected to the water chilling unit (1) through the main flow path (9) to form a circulation loop; the inflow section of the main microchannel heat exchanger (5) is positioned between the oppositely arranged electromagnetic arrays (7), and the outflow section is arranged in contact with the chip (12); the auxiliary cooling unit is attached to the upper surface and the lower surface of the inflow section of the main micro-channel heat exchanger (5) and communicated with the water chilling unit (1); a nano magnetic fluid is arranged in the main flow path (9), the nano magnetic fluid is excited and heated under the action of a magnetic field generated by the electromagnetic array (7) when flowing through the inflow section, the auxiliary cooling unit is used for absorbing heat generated in the excitation process of the nano magnetic fluid and cooling the excited nano magnetic fluid, and the cooled nano magnetic fluid is demagnetized and cooled when flowing through the outflow section and absorbs heat generated by the chip (12); and the fixed-point cooling of the hot point of the chip is realized by controlling the magnetic field area generated by each micro-channel of the inflow section of the electromagnetic array (7) corresponding to the main micro-channel heat exchanger (5).

title: Liquid cooling plate, heat exchange structure between chip and cooling plate and preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to the field of chip heat dissipation, in particular to a liquid cooling plate, a heat exchange structure between the chip and the cold plate and a preparation method thereof, wherein the liquid cooling plate comprises a cold plate main body and a liquid cooling structure positioned in the cold plate main body, and is characterized in that a metal nanowire array grows on one surface of the cold plate main body facing a heat-conducting component and is used as a carrier connected between the heat-conducting component and the cold plate main body, the metal nanowire array grows in situ on the cold plate main body, the metal nanowire array grows in situ on the cold plate to replace a thermal interface material smeared on the cold plate, so that the cold plate and the heat-conducting component have good heat conducting performance, heat emitted by the heat-conducting component can be conducted to the cold plate through the metal nanowire array, and then is conducted to the outside through the cold plate, and better heat dissipation of the heat-conducting component can be achieved.
